description: Derive the 64-byte binary seed from a mnemonic word list using PBKDF2 with HMAC-SHA512, 2048 iterations, the space-joined mnemonic as the password and the constant string "mnemonic" as the salt. The word list is validated first, so a disallowed word count or an out-of-dictionary word is rejected with the same neutral error contract used for validation. On success the 64-byte seed is reported as a lowercase hex string.
